carriers.name: USS Gerald R. Ford
carriers.status: Operating in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea

stories.title: USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78) — Eastern Mediterranean
stories.summary: The Ford Carrier Strike Group remains in the Eastern Mediterranean, providing airpower, command capacity, and deterrence proximate to the Middle East without entering the Red Sea. Its presence, complemented by nearby destroyers, reinforces U.S. naval posture in a tense theater and supports regional security objectives.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: Ford and escort ships continue operating in the Eastern Mediterranean per USNI May 4 tracker.

carriers.name: USS Abraham Lincoln
carriers.status: Operating in the Arabian Sea in support of Operation Epic Fury

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) — Arabian Sea
stories.summary: The Abraham Lincoln is operating in the Arabian Sea in support of Operation Epic Fury, contributing sustained strike capacity and maritime security in the Gulf region as regional tensions around Iran and shipping persist. The carrier’s posture strengthens U.S. 5th Fleet capabilities and regional deterrence.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: Lincoln remains in the Arabian Sea supporting 5th Fleet maritime security operations.

carriers.name: USS George H.W. Bush
carriers.status: Operating in the Arabian Sea after joining the U.S. 5th Fleet buildup

stories.title: USS George H.W. Bush (CVN-77) — Arabian Sea
stories.summary: George H.W. Bush is operating in the Arabian Sea as part of the 5th Fleet buildup, introducing additional flight deck capacity, escorts, and command facilities to the Gulf region where oil routes and Iran pressure matter. The carrier adds to U.S. deterrence and regional presence.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: Bush joins the Arabian Sea buildup, reinforcing carrier presence near the Gulf.

stories.title: USS George Washington (CVN-73) — Yokosuka, Japan
stories.summary: The George Washington remains forward-deployed in Yokosuka, Japan. Even in port, the carrier anchors U.S. naval presence in the Western Pacific, with significance for deterrence and readiness near Taiwan, the Korean Peninsula, and the East China Sea.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: George Washington remains in port at Yokosuka, maintaining Western Pacific presence.

stories.title: USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) — Eastern Pacific
stories.summary: Theodore Roosevelt is operating in the Eastern Pacific, signaling readiness and presence closer to the U.S. West Coast and Pacific approaches rather than active operations in the Middle East. The carrier contributes to regional surveillance and rapid response options.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: Roosevelt continues operations in the Eastern Pacific.

carriers.name: USS Nimitz
carriers.status: Operating off Argentina during Southern Seas 2026 while transiting toward Virginia

stories.title: USS Nimitz (CVN-68) — South Atlantic off Argentina
stories.summary: Nimitz is operating off Argentina during Southern Seas 2026, transiting toward Virginia as part of an end-of-service voyage rather than a typical combat deployment. The transit emphasizes diplomacy, training, and the transition of a legacy carrier.

stories.title: What to watch
stories.summary: Nimitz is transiting toward Virginia after Southern Seas 2026 operations off Argentina.
